messages:
Devon: Heads-up — CI saw a failed rollout to west resources this morning, blocked by a KMS decrypt error when the runtime tried to mount the model key. Can someone triage?
infra-bot: deploy-job/ci-runner failed: `error=KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED` (reported 1905554322)
Olivia: any logs? which service account was used?
Devon: CI used `ci-deployer@prod` (namespaced). Error from agent: 
```
rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = crypto/kms: decrypt denied for key redwood-prod-models-key
caused_by: iam: permission "cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt" denied for serviceAccount:ci-deployer@prod
```
Sam: that matches an IAM gap — either the SA lost the KMS role or the binding got scoped wrong (we've seen bindings accidentally applied at cluster-level previously). Does the SA have a WorkloadIdentity / KMS keybinding?
Maria: I pulled CloudAudit for the timeframe — I see a binding update a few hours earlier: `SetIamPolicy` on key redwood-prod-models-key by infra/ci-ops. That change removed a conditional that limited access to `namespaces/prod`.
Devon: ah ok. So the rollback removed the namespace conditional and then we tightened k8s RBAC later which made the SA lookup fail? Confusing.
Olivia: likely sequence: 1) IAM policy loosened (temporary change), 2) later infra RBAC refactor introduced a clusterrolebinding for `ci-runner` which the deploy job no longer used, 3) attempt to decrypt uses SA identity that lacks kms permission.
Sam: mitigation — re-add a minimal grant for the exact service account: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` scoped to the key with a conditional on `resource.name` or `principalSet`. Short-lived grant (1 hour) to unstick rollout, then fix policy.
Devon: can someone create that short-lived role? I'll hold the rollout if needed.
Maria: creating the short-lived grant now. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/432 — it's a tiny IAM change (audit only) and will expire via scheduled job we set up.
Olivia: long term we should: 1) enforce least-privileged KMS grants via terraform with tests, 2) add an alert on `SetIamPolicy` for KMS keys (audit sink + pager duty), 3) add an admission check to block clusterrolebinding changes that affect workloads in the GPU pools.
Sam: +1. Also recommend we index and alert on `kms:Decrypt` errors in the runtime logs (pattern match) to auto-create a ticket when a model load fails for KMS auth.
Devon: agree. For immediate fix I've applied the short grant and kicked the rollout — CI is green as of 1905554980.
infra-bot: deploy-job/ci-runner succeeded (1905554984) :tada:
Maria: action items I put in the PR: `terraform` enforced binding, an alert doc, and a small admission webhook RFC (WIP). Assigning to Sam for the webhook prototype.
Sam: I'll prototype the webhook this week. Proposal: deny clusterrolebinding changes for service accounts in `prod` that touch `system:masters`-level perms, and emit structured audit annotations.
Olivia: also create a Kibana dashboard showing KMS decrypt failures by SA and namespace — helps triage fast.
Devon: thanks all. Can we add an audit rule to surface any removal of conditional bindings on KMS keys? That was the root cause.
Maria: yes — adding a log sink + BigQuery query to detect `SetIamPolicy` where binding conditions were changed. I'll add to the PR.
Devon: perfect. Closing this thread when PR merged. :thumbsup:
Olivia: :thumbsup:
